description:

comments.text:
## Least-invasive path (lesson from 5ee)

The 5ee rebase surfaced a fragile toolchain: package.json requires @earendil-works/pi-ai & pi-tui >=0.84.0, but the installed top-level copies are 0.75.5 — vitest collection fails (`"./compat" is not exported`), and any new pi-ai/pi-tui API import typechecks against 0.84 while runtime ships 0.75. General rule for implementing this issue — choose the least invasive path:
- Text-only changes over structural ones (descriptions, wording, comments)
- Additive hooks at a single existing funnel (removeRecord, notification render) instead of new pipes
- No new dependencies or settings surfaces unless the issue explicitly demands them; prefer per-call params over global config
- Keep the diff minimal; if a test breaks, prefer a local workaround (e.g. version-aligned node_modules copy) over widening the change

## Review: defects requiring correction

## Least-invasive path (lesson from 5ee)

The 5ee rebase surfaced a fragile toolchain: package.json requires @earendil-works/pi-ai & pi-tui >=0.84.0, but the installed top-level copies are 0.75.5 — vitest collection fails (`"./compat" is not exported`), and any new pi-ai/pi-tui API import typechecks against 0.84 while runtime ships 0.75. Changes that (a) bump deps, (b) import new symbols from pi-ai/pi-tui, or (c) touch settings schema validation, can silently break the whole test toolchain, not just the feature.

General rule for implementing this issue — choose the least invasive path:
- Text-only changes over structural ones (descriptions, wording, comments)
- Additive hooks at a single existing funnel (removeRecord, notification render) instead of new pipes
- No new dependencies or settings surfaces unless the issue explicitly demands them; prefer per-call params over global config
- Keep the diff minimal; if a test breaks, prefer a local workaround (e.g. version-aligned node_modules copy) over widening the change

Specific to this issue: Pure description-string edits only — no structural promptGuidelines refactors in one pass. Note workflow-tool-description.test.ts asserts on the rendered description (e.g. no '[object Object]'), so keep interpolations static or test-verified. Wording fixes (polling, @handle, schedule line) are safe text-only changes.
